Hosts compare case-insensitively, the endpoint path case-sensitively. A custom domain whose host is not the bucket name, or a service host that happens to begin with `YOUR_BUCKET_NAME.`, must say which it is. On a path-style device, a listing or `deletePath()` prefix outside the bucket, or holding a `.` or `..` segment, throws `InvalidArgumentException` before any request is made. `deletePath()` treats its path as a directory, so `deletePath('images')` leaves `images-archive/` alone, and throws `RemoteException` when the service keeps any of the objects.
